import html # Predefined HTML template for a blog post. The placeholders `{title}` and `{body}` # will be replaced by the sanitized title and body. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def format_post_content(post_title: str, post_body: str) -> str: """ Sanitize and format a blog post for safe HTML rendering. Parameters ---------- post_title : str The headline or title of the blog post. post_body : str The full text content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and HTML-formatted blog post. """ # Escape any characters that could form malicious scripts safe_title = html.escape(post_title, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(post_body, quote=True) # Insert the escaped values into the template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
